PROJECTS_REDRAGON_DESCRIPTION: Born out of reverse engineering of OEM drivers and proprietary USB HID protocols of the Redragon M719RGB-PRO MCU. Built from scratch in Rust to replace legacy software, enabling direct EEPROM manipulation, custom mapping, and porting support to macOS and Linux, platforms originally unsupported by Redragon's proprietary software.
PROJECTS_RDR2MAP_DESCRIPTION: A complete interactive map for Red Dead Redemption 2 built with Angular 22, MapLibre GL, and Tailwind CSS v4. A closed-source project with a live online version available, featuring local raster tile pyramids with smooth overzooming, 21 high-res interior and cave floorplans, over 6,160 locations across 66 categories, 68 wildlife spawn heatmaps, and unlimited progress tracking with multi-profile JSON save/import.
PROJECTS_BUS_DESCRIPTION: App for checking schedules, routes, and real-time bus locations in Brasília/DF. Allows you to view nearby stops and plan routes.
PROJECTS_BEAUTYGLOW_DESCRIPTION: Static website developed exclusively in front-end for the professional presentation of the work of a SENAC-DF class. Published with simple integration via GitHub Pages, prioritizing performance, responsiveness, and clarity in communication.
PROJECTS_SMARTHOME_DESCRIPTION: Responsive website developed focused on integrated use with an Arduino capable of remotely controlling residential electronic devices via the internet. Published with simple integration via GitHub Pages, prioritizing accessibility for people with total blindness.
PROJECTS_YOUTUBE_DESCRIPTION: Desktop Python application for easily downloading YouTube videos and audio tracks in high resolution, featuring a clean and intuitive user interface.
